changes: Paths are package-relative or explicit STUDY_WORK_DIR / STUDY_MODEL_DIR.
Private requester-name matching and internal mapping files are omitted; the frozen coded exclusion set is retained.
Ranking arithmetic is copied from the archived reviewed-ranking function; output returns values instead of replacing historical artifacts.
Normalization retains the actual selection/tokenization algorithm but omits requester identity discovery and its private output.
Paid and network operations are never invoked by offline replay; an explicit paid opt-in is required for new generation.
No unrelated historical corpus, API secrets, model caches, participant names, signed forms or raw feedback are included.
Embeddings (87,101 x 384) and raw API pages are not distributed; frozen dense similarities, model revision, encoder implementation, runtime and chunk hashes are included.
